purpose: formalize the first discovery gate for CEUNIA MCP interoperability

protocol_basis.auto_policy: discover first, fall back only when discovery is unsupported

epistemic_boundary: The protocol discovery procedure is verified from current official MCP SDK documentation; no live server/discover response was obtained in this experiment.
evidence: Official MCP SDK documentation states that 2026-07-28 servers implement server/discover and that auto negotiation probes discovery before falling back to the legacy initialize handshake.
next_required: Expose a real Serena MCP transport or endpoint. Execute discovery against the live server, preserve the raw response, hash it, and use the observed protocol/capabilities to drive CEI-027.
